SurfaceDesc: Select a <u>Combat</u> or <u>Elite</u> domain to immediately get the rewards of the domain and change it to a <u>Blank</u> domain (The effects of Curios do not activate simultaneously)
Select an <u>Occurrence</u>, <u>Occurrence: Abnormal</u>, or <u>Reward</u> Domain. Obtain <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> Blessing(s) for every Occurrence in the domain, and turn it into <u>Blank</u> Domain

After the current movement, immediately turn all adjacent domains to the right of the current domain (excluding <u>Boss</u> and <u>Blank</u>) into <u>Blank</u> Domains. For each domain changed, gain <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> Cosmic Fragments and <unbreak>2[i]</unbreak> random Blessing(s)
Select 1 domain (excluding <u>Boss</u>) and turn it into <u>Combat</u> Domain
Immediately turn a random domain (excluding <u>Boss</u>) into <u>Occurrence</u> Domain or <u>Occurrence: Abnormal</u> Domain
Select 1 domain (excluding <u>Boss</u>). Immediately copy the current domain onto the selected domain and apply the <u>Knowledge</u> effect
Select 1 domain (excluding <u>Boss</u>). Immediately copy the selected domain onto an adjacent domain (excluding <u>Boss</u>) and apply the <u>Knowledge</u> effect
Select 1 domain (excluding <u>Boss</u>) and randomly reshuffle all domains of that type in the current plane, with each reshuffle granting <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> Cosmic Fragments
Select 1 domain (excluding <u>Boss</u>) and turn <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> random adjacent domain(s) into the same type as the selected domain
Select 1 domain, copy the selected domain to <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> random location(s) on the current plane, and apply <u>Knowledge</u> to it (excluding <u>Boss</u>)
Select 1 <u>Combat</u> Domain (excluding <u>Boss</u>) and turn <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> random adjacent domain(s) into <u>Combat</u> Domain
Immediately turn 1 random <u>Elite</u> Domain or <u>Adventure</u> Domain into a Reward Domain
Select 1 <u>Combat</u> or <u>Elite</u> Domain and switch it with a random domain adjacent to the current domain

Select 1 <u>Combat</u>, <u>Elite</u>, <u>Occurrence</u>, <u>Occurrence: Abnormal</u>, or <u>Reward</u> Domain and apply a random beacon to it. Then, switch it with a random domain adjacent to the current domain
Select 1 <u>Combat</u> domain with beacon. Immediately obtain the reward in the domain and change it into <u>Blank</u> Domain (The effects of Curios do not activate simultaneously)
Immediately copy the current domain to <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> random location(s) on the current plane and apply <u>Knowledge</u> to it (excluding <u>Boss</u>)

For every 1 domain on the current plane that contains a <u>Blessing Trotter</u> or <u>Curio Trotter</u> beacon, immediately gain <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> Cosmic Fragments. These domains then all swap their positions with a random adjacent domain.
Immediately generates <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> random beacon(s) on the current plane
Immediately generates <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> <u>Blessing Trotter</u> or <u>Curio Trotter</u> beacon(s) in random <u>Combat</u> or <u>Elite</u> domain(s)
Immediately generates <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> random beacon(s) in random domain(s) with <u>Knowledge</u>
Immediately applies <u>Knowledge</u> to <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> random domain(s) that don't yet have <u>Knowledge</u> on this plane
Immediately generates <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> random beacon(s) in random domain(s) on this plane (This effect will not be generated again after taking effect for 1 time on this plane)
Immediately applies <u>Knowledge</u> to <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> domain(s) adjacent to each domain with <u>Knowledge</u> on this plane
Immediately applies <u>Knowledge</u> to <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> random domain(s) that don't yet have <u>Knowledge</u> on this plane
Select 1 domain with <u>Knowledge</u> and apply <u>Knowledge</u> to all its adjacent domains
After the current movement, immediately applies <u>Knowledge</u> to <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> random domain(s) that are about to collapse.
After the current movement, immediately applies <u>Knowledge</u> to <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> random domain(s) adjacent to the domain where characters are located
After the current movement, immediately applies <u>Knowledge</u> to all domains adjacent to the domain where characters are located
After the current movement, immediately applies <u>Knowledge</u> to all domains that are about to collapse

For every type of domain that has <u>Knowledge</u> on the current plane, immediately obtain <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> random Blessing(s) (A maximum of <unbreak>2[i]</unbreak> random Blessings can be obtained)
When entering a <u>Combat</u> or <u>Elite</u> domain during the current movement, obtain <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> Blessing(s)
When entering an <u>Occurrence</u>, <u>Occurrence: Abnormal</u>, or <u>Reward</u> domains during the current movement, increase the countdown by <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak>
During the current movement, when entering a domain of the same type as the one where characters are currently in, receive Blessings <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> times

When entering a domain with <u>Knowledge</u> during this movement, receive <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> Cosmic Fragments. When entering a domain with a beacon during this movement, receive Blessings <unbreak>2[i]</unbreak> times
When entering a domain with <u>Knowledge</u> during this movement, apply <u>Knowledge</u> to <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> random domains on the current plane
When entering a domain with a beacon during this movement, generate <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> <u>Blessing Trotter</u> or <u>Curio Trotter</u> beacon(s) on the current plane

During this movement, can move to a domain in the closest column that contains either a <u>Blessing Trotter</u> beacon or <u>Curio Trotter</u> beacon. Rewards gained from defeating Trotters are doubled
Can move to any domain in the next 3 columns during the current movement
Can move to any domain with <u>Knowledge</u> during the current movement
Can move to any domain with a beacon during the current movement
Select 1 <u>Elite</u> or <u>Reward</u> Domain and turn it into an <u>Adventure</u> Domain
Select 1 domain with a beacon and immediately swap its beacon into a different type of beacon, then receive 1 random Blessing
After the current movement, for every domain that collapses, immediately obtains <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> Cosmic Fragment(s)
For every type of beacon that exists on the current plane, immediately obtain 1 random Blessing (A maximum of <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> random Blessings can be obtained)
Immediately change all beacons on the current Plane into random beacons, then generate 1 random beacon
Immediately turn 1 random domain with <u>Knowledge</u> into an <u>Adventure</u> Domain (excluding <u>Boss</u> Domains)
Discard Curio 1 time and obtain <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> Cosmic Fragments (This will not take effect when no Curios can be discarded)
Obtain 1 Curio and 1 random Negative Curio (This effect will not be generated again after taking effect for 1 time on this plane)
Discard 1 Curio and obtain it again
Immediately turn <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> random domain(s) into <u>Transaction</u> Domain(s) (excluding <u>Boss</u>)
When entering <u>Transaction</u> Domain during this movement, obtain <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> Cosmic Fragments
Select 1 <u>Elite</u>, <u>Adventure</u>, or <u>Reward</u> Domain and turn it into a <u>Transaction</u> Domain, then obtain <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> Cosmic Fragments
For every Curio that you own, immediately obtain <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> Cosmic Fragments

For the current movement, can move to a <u>Transaction</u> Domain in the closest column. The cost of items in that domain increases by <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak>, however both the Curio Store and the Blessing Store will contain 1 random free item
Consume 1 point of countdown or increase Disruption level by 1 to instantly get <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> Cosmic Fragment(s)
Obtain 1 random Negative Curio and add 1 point in the countdown (This will not take effect when no Negative Curios can be obtained)
Discard Curio 1 time and add <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> point(s) in the countdown (This will not take effect when no Curios can be discarded)
Select 1 <u>Reward</u> or <u>Adventure</u> Domain, turn it into a <u>Blank</u> Domain, and gain <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> point(s) in the countdown
Select 1 domain with <u>Knowledge</u> and apply <u>Knowledge</u> to <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> of its random adjacent domains
Select 1 domain and apply <u>Knowledge</u> to it
Select 1 domain. Make it and all its adjacent domains lose <u>Knowledge</u>. For every <u>Knowledge</u> lost in this way, receive <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> Cosmic Fragments
For every domain on the current plane that has <u>Knowledge</u>, immediately obtain <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> Cosmic Fragments
Select 1 domain with <u>Knowledge</u>, turn it into a <u>Blank</u> Domain with <u>Knowledge</u>, and obtain Blessings 1 time (excluding <u>Blank</u> and <u>Boss</u> domains)

When entering combat during the current movement, characters gain a Shield equal to <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> of their Max HP for <unbreak>2[i]</unbreak> turns. At the beginning of each turn, this Shield additionally increases by <unbreak>3[i]%</unbreak> of the affected ally's Max HP.
When entering combat this time, reduce all enemies' Effect RES by <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> and Control RES by <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>3[i]</unbreak> turns.

When entering combat in this movement, after a character uses Basic ATK, for every 1 turn (up to <unbreak>2[i]</unbreak> turns) that remains for the DoT on the attacked target, immediately deals DMG equal to <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> of the original DMG and removes the DoT. This effect lasts for <unbreak>3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
When entering combat in this movement, every time allies restore HP, they will restore additional HP equal to <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> of their Max HP, lasting for <unbreak>2[i]</unbreak> turn(s)
When entering combat in this movement, increase the SPD of all allies by <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

When entering combat in this movement, allies will not receive DMG exceeding <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> of their Max HP in a single attack. This effect lasts for <unbreak>2[i]</unbreak> turn(s), and can be triggered for up to 1 time per each turn.
When entering combat in this movement, all allies' Follow-Up ATK DMG dealt ignores <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> of the target's DEF, lasting for <unbreak>2[i]</unbreak> turn(s)
When entering combat in this movement, for every <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> Skill Point(s) allies have consumed, they recover 1 Skill Point, lasting for <unbreak>2[i]</unbreak> turn(s)

When entering combat in this movement, allies casting their Ultimate will Advance their action Forward by <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak>. This effect can only be triggered once for every <unbreak>2[i]</unbreak> turn(s), lasting for <unbreak>3[i]</unbreak> turn(s)

When entering combat in this movement, for every <unbreak>100</unbreak> Cosmic Fragments in possession, characters using attacks will deal Additional DMG equal to <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> of their ATK to the attacked enemy target, lasting for <unbreak>2[i]</unbreak> turn(s)

When entering combat in this movement, at the start of the enemy target's turn, the enemy target will consume HP equal to <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> of their Max HP if their current HP is <unbreak>50%</unbreak> of their Max HP or higher. This effect lasts for <unbreak>2[i]</unbreak> turn(s)

When entering combat in this movement, for every domain that has <u>Knowledge</u> on the current plane, all enemies receive a set amount of DMG equal to <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak> of their respective Max HP, not exceeding <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak> of their Max HP

When entering combat in this movement, all allies' ATK increases by <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak>. For every Blessing owned, increases ATK by an additional <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak>, lasting for <unbreak>3[i]</unbreak> turn(s)

When entering combat in this movement, all allies' Max HP increases by <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak>. For every Curio owned, increases Max HP by an additional <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak>, lasting for <unbreak>3[i]</unbreak> turn(s)
Immediately generates <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> <u>Double</u> or <u>Choice</u> Beacon(s) in <u>Occurrence</u>, <u>Occurrence: Abnormal</u> or <u>Reward</u> domains
Choose a domain with any number of beacons in it and remove all beacons in it, then receive <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> Cosmic Fragments
You may move to the nearest <u>Elite</u> or <u>Reward</u> domain in this movement
